models.purpose: Estimate native-vegetation carbon components from applicable SAR, inventory, and mapped-soil inputs with explicit provenance.
models.equation_or_method: Stratified component accounting; use directly measured or source-matched component values, with no generic mean substituted for missing evidence.
models.uncertainty_semantics: Publish only source-provided ranges, conditional model ranges, or deterministic scenario envelopes with their exact labels; otherwise return N/D.
models.domain_limits: AOI strata, fitophysiognomy, component and source coverage must match the selected evidence; transfer is not field-validated.
models.abstention_rule: Return N/D per component when source, unit, depth, class match, or required inputs are absent; do not total incomplete necromass subpools.

models.purpose: Provide a conditional belowground biomass estimate from AGB using the implemented root allometry.
models.equation_or_method: Log-log root-to-shoot allometry with Monte Carlo propagation only when coefficient covariance, residual error, AGB uncertainty and domain calibration are supplied.
models.uncertainty_semantics: A conditional predictive range is not an AOI confidence interval or a demonstrated coverage rate; without calibration inputs, uncertainty is not quantified and the result must be withheld from uncertainty-qualified totals.
models.domain_limits: Only the forest and physiognomic domains documented by the supplied calibration; no universal transfer across Brazilian biomes.
models.abstention_rule: Do not report an uncertainty-qualified estimate without all calibration terms; retain explicit N/D/conditional status.

models.purpose: Calculate an explicitly conditional soil-organic-carbon stock envelope from five complete physical-input horizons.
models.equation_or_method: For each horizon, thickness × fine-earth bulk density × organic-carbon mass fraction × fine-earth volume fraction; sum 0–5, 5–15, 15–30, 30–60 and 60–100 cm.
models.uncertainty_semantics: Physical-input scenario envelope only; not a prediction interval, confidence interval, or field-validated error range.
models.domain_limits: All five exact horizons, compatible AOI class and physiognomy, licensed traceable inputs, and declared fine-earth bulk-density basis.
models.abstention_rule: N/D if any horizon, license, source trace, bulk-density basis, or compatible domain is missing; never substitute 0–30 cm for 0–100 cm.

models.purpose: Screen recent radar observations for temporal cover-change signals and candidate land-use states.
models.equation_or_method: Orbit-aware temporal VV/VH feature extraction and candidate screening; unsupported crop-specific labels abstain.
models.output_units: class probabilities or explicit status categories
models.uncertainty_semantics: Sensor and classifier confidence only where computed; no Brazilian farm-level accuracy claim without independent spatial holdout.
models.domain_limits: Valid SAR pixels, acquisition dates, orbit, polarization, preprocessing and a matching supported model domain.
models.abstention_rule: Return N/D_VALIDACAO or a broad cover class when model calibration/domain support is absent.

models.purpose: Derive exploratory crop-vigor classes from SAR texture and optional height/reference features.
models.equation_or_method: Block-level VV/VH texture and structure metrics with explicit reference-tercile classification.
models.output_units: class and feature-specific dimensionless or physical metrics
models.uncertainty_semantics: Conditional feature/class uncertainty is distinct from crop-health diagnosis; no field accuracy or disease inference is claimed.
models.domain_limits: Identified crop mask and compatible SAR acquisition, processing, phenology window and reference statistics.
models.abstention_rule: Return unavailable when crop identity, sufficient valid pixels, or reference domain is missing.

models.purpose: Generate exploratory microregion yield scenarios from historical production and available crop/climate inputs.
models.equation_or_method: Robust Theil–Sen trend, detrending, hindcast-error and Monte Carlo scenario propagation as implemented in the module.
models.output_units: t/ha or crop-native yield unit and total production
models.uncertainty_semantics: Scenario/predictive range only with its method and available hindcast support; no forecast coverage claim without independent temporal holdout.
models.domain_limits: Only crop-microregions with verified PAM observations and compatible time series; no pixel-level yield inference from PAM aggregates.
models.abstention_rule: Return unavailable when crop, microregion, sufficient historical years or required climate inputs are absent.

models.purpose: Retrieve daily gridded weather variables for a field centroid and report source and dates.
models.equation_or_method: NASA POWER daily point series with explicit missing-value filtering; degree-day summaries use the declared base temperature.
models.uncertainty_semantics: Grid-cell/reanalysis context is not a station observation; no local weather forecast error is implied.
models.domain_limits: NASA POWER product coverage and the requested coordinate/date range; point values represent gridded data.
models.abstention_rule: Return sem_dados or a missing variable when the source has no valid values; preserve source and retrieval timestamps.

models.purpose: Join an explicitly allowed crop identifier, SAR-derived vigor, microregion PAM history and weather suitability for exploratory yield scenarios.
models.equation_or_method: Calibrated panel model only when a compatible artifact exists; otherwise detrended microregion scenarios and hindcast-error Monte Carlo, as routed by the implementation.
models.output_units: crop-native yield unit per hectare and total production
models.uncertainty_semantics: Keep the scenario or model prediction range and hindcast metrics distinct; no independent temporal coverage claim is made.
models.domain_limits: Requires allowed crop identification, compatible vigor features, sufficient PAM history and weather coverage for the target microregion/season.
models.abstention_rule: Return N/D for a field when crop identity, vigor, PAM years or climate suitability is unavailable.

models.purpose: Render separate native-carbon and cultivated-area panels while retaining source status and uncertainty labels.
models.equation_or_method: Deterministic rendering of the structured analysis report; it does not estimate or validate measurements.
models.uncertainty_semantics: Uncertainty is inherited from the input report and must not be upgraded by rendering.
models.domain_limits: Only fields supplied in the analysis report; missing inputs remain N/D.
models.abstention_rule: Render missing or unvalidated values as unavailable/experimental rather than using placeholders as observed stocks.

models.purpose: Verify that the compiled Windows package contains required modules, data and a source-SHA stamp.
models.equation_or_method: Deterministic runtime/import and packaging contract checks; synthetic fixtures are software fixtures only.
models.output_units: pass/fail software status and JSON diagnostics
models.uncertainty_semantics: A software pass does not estimate scientific uncertainty or establish model accuracy.
models.domain_limits: The exact Windows executable and source SHA exercised by the build workflow.
models.abstention_rule: Fail the packaging check when the executable lacks required resources or exact source identity.

models.purpose: Exercise the separate native-carbon and cultivated-area report contracts.
models.equation_or_method: Deterministic software regression tests over declared inputs; tests do not count as field observations.
models.uncertainty_semantics: No empirical model uncertainty or classification accuracy is inferred from a passing test.
models.domain_limits: The tested report schemas and assertions in this repository revision.
models.abstention_rule: Fail when the tested contract does not match; preserve scientific evidence gates independently.

models.purpose: Gate crop labels behind an actual calibrated SAR model, per-class thresholds, independent validation and compatible regional phenology/height evidence.
models.equation_or_method: Late fusion accepts an externally calibrated SAR probability only after its independent evidence contract; regional phenology/height is a compatibility veto, not added probability.
models.output_units: class probability or explicit abstention status
models.uncertainty_semantics: No class-accuracy claim is made from the model registry, map pseudolabels, or a passed software test.
models.domain_limits: Crop-specific weights and independent calibration are not currently present for every crop/region/season; SAR inputs must match the model feature schema.
models.abstention_rule: Return ABSTENCAO/N/D_VALIDACAO until real weights, calibrated thresholds and independent evidence are supplied; do not promote map-derived pseudolabels to field truth.

models.purpose: Intersect official mapped soil units with the AOI and report unit areas and coverage.
models.equation_or_method: Vector geometry intersection in equal-area projection with explicit AOI coverage and unit accounting.
models.output_units: soil unit, ha and percent of AOI
models.uncertainty_semantics: Map scale and unit-association uncertainty are descriptive; this is not a soil laboratory diagnosis.
models.domain_limits: Only official soil-unit geometry available from the declared Embrapa service and its mapping scale.
models.abstention_rule: Return unavailable with service/error reason when the official layer or geometry cannot be read; do not disaggregate association components into measured classes.

models.purpose: Calculate AOI-weighted mapped soil-fertility attributes from numeric raster coverages where access and coverage are verified.
models.equation_or_method: Fractional AOI-pixel intersection weights, NoData-aware zonal means and explicit coverage by attribute/depth.
models.output_units: attribute-specific physical units and map coverage
models.uncertainty_semantics: Spatial map dispersion is descriptive, not prediction error or lab uncertainty; no value is interpolated from soil class alone.
models.domain_limits: Only numeric, accessible and correctly identified official rasters with known units/depth; method and licensing must be checked per layer.
models.abstention_rule: Return N/D for unavailable coverage, ambiguous units/depth, unsupported licence or insufficient pixels; fertility remains separate from SOC stock.
